manankharwar/fusioncore#161.headline: Add tests to the robot-config converter and stop it crashing on empty files
manankharwar/fusioncore#161.plain_problem: A script that converts robot configs into FusionCore configs has no tests, and it crashes with a confusing error on empty files.
files_explained: .github/workflows/ci.yml: runs the new tests automatically on every change, next to the project's other checks
tools/rl_to_fusioncore.py: instead of crashing with a confusing error, it now says clearly when the input file is empty or isn't valid
tools/test_rl_to_fusioncore.py: a new file with 9 tests that run the converter on small sample configs, including empty and broken ones

duckdb/duckdb#26144.headline: Stop a prepared query that uses a sequence from breaking the whole session
duckdb/duckdb#26144.plain_problem: Asking DuckDB to prepare a query that takes a number from a sequence breaks the whole session, and every later query fails until you restart it.
